ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extreme low-intensity bias; approximately 95:5 ratio of dark-to-light pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant, continuous dark-intensity field across both lobes; isolated, sparse high-intensity (white) point-source clusters distributed non-uniformly on the lower-left and center-bottom quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees relative to the horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the continuous boundary; pixel-amplitude variations range from 4 to 12 pixels in depth from the local edge mean.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature extending from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters on the lower-center and mid-left lobe surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular pixel-discontinuity and high-texture erosion-like markers on the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
